preconditions.expression: isinstance(grid, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: grid is a 2D list (list of lists).

preconditions.expression: 1 <= len(grid) <= 500 and all(1 <= len(row) <= 500 for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The dimensions m and n are between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(cell, str) and len(cell) == 1 and cell.islower() for cell in row) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Every cell in grid is a single lowercase English letter.

postconditions.expression: return_value == any(has_cycle(grid, start_r, start_c) for start_r in range(len(grid)) for start_c in range(len(grid[0])))
postconditions.description: The function returns True if and only if there exists at least one cycle of the same value in the grid, where a cycle is a path of length 4 or more starting and ending at the same cell, moving only to adjacent cells with the same value, and never immediately revisiting the cell just left.
